LOG OUT?

This signs you out and removes your login and saved progress from this device. Your coins, cars, upgrades, levels, and stats stay saved to your account — log in again with your name and password (on this or any other device) to get them back.

REMOVE ACCOUNT?

This permanently deletes your racer name, coins, cars, upgrades, levels, stats, friends, and messages — from this device AND from the server. There is no way to undo this or get your progress back.
